title.narrative: Integrating Conflict Sensitivity in GGGI

description.narrative: This project will span GGGI’s global, regional and national level efforts on conflict sensitivity, and will combine both strategic and operational actions to mainstream and ensure a delivery that its considerate of conflict/peace whe n and where relevant in the pertinent conflict affected settings that GGGI operates. It aims to maximize co/benefits in terms of peace, social cohesion and conflict de escalation where and whenever possible, as well as to have an integrative approach to coordinate with the ongoing efforts to protect staff/consultants, in line with the security policy plans at HQ, regional and country levels.

This project will span GGGI’s global, regional and national levels and will combine both strategic and operational actions for genuinely mainstreaming conflict sensitivity into the delivery in relevant conflict affected settings. There are three specific outcomes/objectives: 1. CS approach integration in strategic documents, processes and systems at the global level. T he GESI strategy 2026-2039 has been identified as the best place to strategically anchor conflict sensitivity and environmental peacebuilding for GGGI. 2. Strengthening staff capacities on CS approach in LAC and Africa countries. Outputs at this level will focus on promoting learning and knowledge exchange within and among Africa and LAC regions, gathering information to inform global strategic documents, processes and systems, and identifying areas of further institutional development. 3. Integration of CS approach into RM at regional and country levels. Outputs at this level will focus on identifying funding opportunities and matching them with GGGI’s country program’s interest to develop concept notes and full proposals for RM with a CS lens.
